command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_uia_dump.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
PROFILE=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-uia-dump"
if owned.exists(): shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir(); (owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
 encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata"); env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(PROFILE)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
spec=None
try:
 end=time.monotonic()+20
 while time.monotonic()<end:
  ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=p.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
  if len(ws)==1:
   spec=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=ws[0].handle); break
  time.sleep(.25)
 if spec is None: raise RuntimeError("window missing")
 time.sleep(5)
 wrap=spec.wrapper_object()
 print("WINDOW_TITLE",repr(wrap.window_text()),flush=True)
 allnodes=wrap.descendants()
 print("ALL_NODE_COUNT",len(allnodes),flush=True)
 for x in allnodes:
  try:
   ct=x.element_info.control_type
   aid=x.element_info.automation_id
   name=x.element_info.name or x.window_text() or ""
   if ct in ("List","ListItem","Image","Text"):
    print("NODE",ct,repr(aid),repr(name),flush=True)
  except Exception: pass
finally:
 if p.poll() is None:
  try:
   c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(spec.wrapper_object().handle,0x10,0,0); p.wait(timeout=8)
  except Exception:
   p.terminate(); p.wait(timeout=5)
print("EXIT",p.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
